- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:858-874 | severity=medium | confidence=3

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3939-3948 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Fetching PR labels fails open to an empty value on API error, bypassing the e2e-smoke-test auto-merge suppression.
  WHY: Some reviewers treated the fail-open behavior as an acceptable tradeoff, but others flagged that a transient API failure can make the label check miss `e2e-smoke-test` and allow auto-merge to proceed.
